name: A Salem Witch Trial
source: When a murdered family is discovered in 17th Century Salem, at the height of a witch hysteria, people start to suspect something supernatural to blame. An atmospheric murder mystery. Connect the evidence and see if you can deduce the secrets behind the mystery.
translation: 17世纪，塞勒姆正处于女巫恐慌最严重的时期，人们发现一家人惨遭杀害，开始怀疑背后有超自然力量作祟。这是一部氛围感十足的谋杀悬疑游戏。串联证据，看看你能否推断出谜团背后的秘密。
